introHtml: Hand wash only bistro mugs offer a classic ceramic feel and a glossy finish that stands up to daily use when cared for properly. Unlike dishwasher-safe options, these mugs often feature delicate metallic accents or specialty glazes that make your logo pop. They are ideal for office breakrooms, coffee shops, or corporate gifts where the mug will be hand washed and appreciated for its aesthetic quality. Choose from a variety of colors and sizes to match your brand.
